summary: Gorax provides a quick guide on how to maximize rewards in the Eve of the Rift event's Nightveil Standoff faction war. Players should complete the Fated Path questionnaire and select the Dark Lady faction (Nightsworn Vanguard), which is leading in reputation points. Accessing the Riftbound All-Star Night web event via the Support Faction Creators button allows players to bind creators. Selecting Gorax as God Envoy and OddOneGam as Preacher ensures the highest possible draw count for the settlement rewards.
tips: Complete the Fated Path questionnaire under the Nightveil Standoff menu to unlock faction selection.
Join the Dark Lady faction (Nightsworn Vanguard) instead of Child of Chaos to stay on the winning side for better draw pool rewards.
Click the Support Faction Creators button to open the Riftbound All-Star Night browser event.
Bind Gorax as your God Envoy and OddOneGam as your Preacher on the web event page to maximize your draw count before settlement.
title: Join Your Faction NOW Before You Miss These Rewards! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
